launches.title: Vellum for Agents
launches.tagline: Describe a boring ops task and get a working AI agent in minutes
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Today, we’re launching Vellum for Agents;** an agent builder that takes a plain description of what you want to automate and asks follow up questions to understand your needs. It connects to your tools, handles the logic, and shows you exactly what the agent is doing so you are never guessing why or how it works. To celebrate our launch we’ll be giving away free credits for everyone who signs up today (worth $100). Launch video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=72TU43fauo4).

We’re a W23 company with deep experience running AI in production. We’ve built AI tooling used by teams at Drata, Redfin, Seeking Alpha, Headspace, and Swisscom to launch and operate real AI solutions.

_That experience led us here._

Today, we’re sharing a new version of Vellum, an agent builder for ops teams. You describe the task you want to automate, and Vellum gives you a working agent in minutes. It asks follow up questions, connects to your tools, handles the logic, and shows you exactly what the agent is doing at every step, so there is no guesswork.

## Common problems on using AI agents

In 2025 I watched as our engineering team gained superpowers. Coding agents like Devin, Claude Code, Cursor seemed to move them to a whole new level. By end of year, 40% of the work was done by agents and their productivity is up 2.5x.

That impact never really reached the rest of the company.For those of us who are not engineers, getting started with agents is still hard.

While the models are good enough to help with Ops, Finance, Sales, and Marketing tasks, there are frequent challenges that we’ve observed:

* Too many off-the-shelf tools that almost work, but break in specific edge cases
* Prompts you tweak over and over, but still do not fully trust
* Logic that becomes hard to manage in drag and drop builders
* Little guidance on what is actually possible with agents
* A lot of technical setup, before anything feels useful

**_There is a huge drop off in the agent adoption funnel and we’re here to fix it._**

## The solution

Today we’re excited to launch the new version of Vellum.

Just explain the task you want to automate and Vellum turns it into a working agent (like Lovable for agents). Vellum will ask follow-up questions to understand what you need and connect to your tools. It handles the logic and makes the agent’s behavior visible, so you’re never guessing what it’s doing or why.

### Agent: Getting from 0 to 1

Once you give Vellum your prompt, it asks a few follow up questions and builds a plan. For some use cases, it will ask which apps to connect and confirm access. When it has everything it needs, it creates the first version of the workflow:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96757&key=user_uploads/1020427/aea05991-1a72-42a9-9f21-f803c82a3616)

### Console: Access run and output details

After you have the first version of your agent, you get a UI that shows exactly how it works and what it does on each run. You can keep refining it with help from the agent itself, whether that’s improving prompts, adding new tools, or adjusting the logic.

To then test your changes, you can run the agent directly from the UI and inspect every decision it makes, like which tools it calls, when it decides to run a web search, and how it arrives at the final output.

We believe our agent logic is among the most reliable out there, and teams reach a working setup much faster compared to other agent builders.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96757&key=user_uploads/1020427/8c4b97e9-0e04-4920-9719-2ef967d6c74e)

### Interact: Run manually, via triggers, API or code

Once you’re happy with how your agent works, you have a few ways to use it. Depending on your use case, you can choose one of the following:

* run the agent through a ready made UI
* vibe code your own UI with one of our integrations (e.g. Lovable)
* run it on a schedule or trigger it through APIs or app events

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96757&key=user_uploads/1020427/77309dfb-ba7c-406d-b4ed-a38aa9d440f2)

## Most common use-cases

If you want to try Vellum today, here are the common agent automations we’ve seen ops teams build:

* **Content generation:** Agents around SEO and GEO keyword research, content analysis, and daily content creation.
* **Sales ops automation:** This is where we’ve seen the most use cases in the last few months. From automated demo prep, to pulling account intelligence from CRMs, to analyzing sales calls and deals.
* **Product ops:** Agents can reliably analyze support tickets and Linear issues, then ping the right DRIs to move things forward.
* **Customer support:** This is where agents really shine today. They can classify all incoming tickets and surface insights, like the best timing for renewals, automatically.

## What we ask

1. **If you have one gnarly task that you’ve been putting out** we ask you to login to Vellum and try to automate it. Share your feedback in this thread or text me at [akash@vellum.ai](mailto:akash@vellum.ai)
2. **Do any of these problems resonate with you?** Please share your experience in creating agents to automate your tasks. We would love to learn more!

launches.title: Vellum Workflows – Quickly prototype and deploy AI chains
launches.tagline: Quickly prototype, deploy, and manage complex chains of LLM calls and the business logic that tie them together.
launches.body:
Hello hello! We’re Noa Flaherty, Akash Sharma, and Sidd Seethepalli from [Vellum](https://www.vellum.ai/).

**Tl;dr** "Workflows" is a new product in Vellum's LLM dev platform that helps you quickly prototype, deploy, and manage complex chains of LLM calls and the business logic that tie them together. We solve the "whack-a-mole" problem encountered by companies that use popular open source frameworks to build AI applications, but are scared to make changes for fear of introducing regressions in production.

**The Problem 😰: Many AI use-cases require chains of prompts, but experimentation and productionization of complex chains is hard.**

We have helped dozens of customers take their AI prototypes to production by delivering tools for efficient prompt engineering, tightly integrated semantic search, prompt versioning, and performance monitoring. However, as the AI industry matures, we’ve found that more and more real-world use-cases require multi-step flows across actions like semantic search, multiple prompts/LLM calls, and bespoke business logic.

For example, if building a customer-support chatbot, you may want to:

1. Use a fast, low-cost, model to categorize an incoming user question
2. Depending on the categorization, query against a different index in a vector store to return relevant context about how to answer the question
3. Feed that context into a prompt that’s been tuned to answer accurately about that topic
4. Feed the output of that prompt into another that rephrases using your brand voice
5. Finally, return the answer to your end user

Unfortunately, existing tools and frameworks don’t make it easy to:

1. Rapidly experiment with these chains both step-by-step and end-to-end – especially if you’re non-technical
2. Make changes with confidence once in production and avoid regressions
3. Gain visibility into the performance of the system both as a whole, and at each step in the chain

**The Solution 🤤: A fully managed platform for experimenting with, deploying, and managing AI workflows that power your app**

Vellum Workflows provides a low-code UI for experimenting with and deploying LLM workflows to power features in your app.

You can construct a workflow using different “Nodes,” define “Input Variables” to the workflow, their values across different “Scenarios” and run with a single click to see the output at each step along the way.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74014&key=user_uploads/1213437/1d62e723-3e99-4eb5-b4bd-5b4eef082579)

_Shown here is one of the workflows used in production by a customer of ours, Miri Health, for powering their health & wellness AI chatbot._

You get immediate feedback on whether your chain/prompts perform the way you expect without having to edit code, inspect console logs, or hop between browser tabs. You can validate that your workflow does what it should across a variety of scenarios / test cases.

Once you’re happy, you can deploy the Workflow directly in Vellum and invoke it through an API via Vellum’s python/node SDKs. Events for nodes that you subscribe to are streamed back using [Server-Sent Events](https://www.w3schools.com/html/html5_serversentevents.asp).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74014&key=user_uploads/1213437/18a82c70-6ee8-4cde-af75-183014f838a0)

_Invoke a workflow via a simple API. Use our officially supported python and node sdks, or roll your own._

By deploying your Workflow through Vellum, you can:

* Mix and match models from different providers without having to integrate with each. Use the best prompt/mode for the job!
* Have a production-ready backend in minutes without having to write, maintain, and host complex code and orchestration logic
* Version your Workflow, see changes over time, and revert with one click
* Get full observability into the production system, viewing inputs, outputs, timestamps, and more for the workflow as a whole, as well as each Node along the way.
* Use role-based access control to determine which team members are allowed to experiment vs update production deployments

Monitor how your workflows are performing in production, with the ability to inspect the inputs/outputs of the workflow as a whole, as well as each step in the chain.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74014&key=user_uploads/1213437/da276020-b865-472f-a569-c767320a5667)

**Looking Ahead**

This is just the beginning! Our beta customers are already asking for things like:

* A/B testing workflows for live experimentation
* Test suites for evaluating that workflows are doing what they should and don’t break after an “improvement” is made
* Composability via nested workflows
* More node types for executing code, making calls to 3rd party APIs, etc.

**Why Vellum?**

Our focus to date has been to provide robust building blocks for creating production-ready AI applications. We’ve seen our customers assemble Vellum-powered Prompts and Semantic Search to create incredible products, version control and debug them using Vellum Deployments, and validate them when making changes using Vellum Test Suites.

Now that we have the building blocks, we’re well-positioned to help you assemble them. Workflows has been in closed-beta for a few weeks now and we already have customers using them to power their entire AI backend in production.

> Vellum Workflows give us the opportunity to really tailor different parts of our product to the end users’ needs without having to invest in tons of custom development, which has dramatically decreased our time to market. As a technical, but non-engineering stakeholder, I’m able to truly participate in the development of the product experience and help deliver personalized AI-powered experiences to customers faster than I could have ever imagined.
>
> **Adam Daigian, Product Lead at Miri Health**

We firmly believe that the best AI-powered products out there will be the result of close collaboration between technical and non-technical team members. We’ve repeatedly seen engineers set up the initial scaffolding, integrations, and guard-rails, while non-technical folks run experiments and tweak prompts/chains. No other platform facilitates this collaboration as well as Vellum.

**Ask: How you can help**

* Sign up for a free 14-day trial if the problems we aim to solve resonate with you. [Click here](https://vellum.ai/landing-pages/14-day-trial).
* Share your thoughts and feedback on our direction in the comments below 👇
* Spread the word with others you think this may help

launches.title: Vellum - Build production-worthy LLM applications
launches.tagline: The developer platform for building production-worthy Large Language Model applications
launches.body:
**TL;DR** [Vellum](http://vellum.ai) (W23) is a developer platform for building production-worthy applications on LLMs like @OpenAI’s GPT-3 or @Anthropic’s Claude. Use Vellum to save hours on prompt engineering, iterate on prompts in production confidently, and continuously fine-tune for better results (we helped one customer save 94% of their LLM costs through fine-tuning!). Request early access [here](https://www.vellum.ai/landing-pages/request-early-access).

—

Hi everyone,

Akash, Noa and Sidd here. We worked together at Dover (YC S19) for 2+ years where we built production use-cases of Large Language Models (LLMs). Noa and Sidd are MIT engineers who previously worked at DataRobot’s MLOps team and Quora’s ML Platform team respectively.

We decided to work on Vellum after realizing that while the MLOps industry has matured rapidly for traditional ML, companies using LLMs don’t have any of this tooling available. Engineering teams spend many hours building custom internal tooling to tame LLMs, taking away time from building their core product.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69757&key=user_uploads/1020427/c77e40f4-74d7-49b8-89cf-650548274362)

# 

# **The LLM Management Problem**

We’ve seen companies building production applications with Large Language Models experience challenges at all stages:

1. **Going from 0 → 1:** ”Prompt engineering” has become an important role in working with LLMs. Today, most people experiment with various prompts across browser tabs and the more diligent track the results of their experimentation in spreadsheets. Rarely do people take the time to test each variant across a sufficient number of test cases, let alone try different parameter combinations and LLM providers. Most settle for a sub-optimal configuration because the testing process is so tedious. Querying for semantically relevant context against a corpus of text to inject in the prompt is another large barrier for many people just getting started.
2. **Managing changes once live in production:** Tracking model & prompt versions, keeping an audit log of inputs/outputs, testing changes to prompts/models before going into production, and measuring aggregate quality metrics are all critical for a production-worthy system, but all require custom code and non-trivial internal tooling. Engineers don’t have time to build out this tooling and instead, fly blind – never sure what their current baseline for quality is or whether “improvements” made to their prompts will in fact break existing behavior.
3. **Post-MVP optimization:** Most people find a semi-reasonable prompt for _text-davinci-003_ and move on. But, they also acknowledge that with more time, they could set up a fine-tuning pipeline, experiment with other models/LLM providers, and try out new foundation models as they’re released to maximize output quality while dramatically reducing LLM provider spend. They’re paying a premium for sub-optimal quality and risk falling behind as new models are released.

# 

# **The Vellum Product**

We have 3 products – each aimed to solve the problems we identified when building production LLM apps ourselves.

### **Vellum Playground: Super powers for prompt engineers**

Create one “sandbox” per LLM use-case. In each, you can try as many prompt variants as you like across as many test cases as you wish. These prompt variants may differ in their text, underlying model, model parameters (e.g. “temperature”), and even LLM provider! Each run is saved as a history item and has a permanent url you can use share with teammates and track results.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69757&key=user_uploads/1020427/3a844278-c463-456f-ae0a-566ecbd29153)

## **Vellum Manage: Confidently iterate on models in production**

Once you’ve settled on a prompt you like, you “deploy” it through Vellum. Vellum acts as a high-reliability, low-latency proxy layer between you and LLM providers. Every request is captured and persisted in one-place, providing observability into your model’s performance. Because the API interface doesn’t change, you can update your prompt (and even the underlying LLM provider!) without making any code changes. Previously made requests can be replayed against proposed changes to gain confidence prior to updating a deployment. All updates are version-controlled and you can revert to prior versions at any time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69757&key=user_uploads/1020427/437adec7-b675-459c-8148-fe7600c20c41)

## **Vellum Optimize: Continuously fine-tune to improve quality and lower cost**

Once you’ve collected data in production for some time through Vellum Manage, these input/output pairs (minimum 100, but depends on the use case), can be used to fine-tune your own proprietary models for better quality, lower cost, or lower latency. Your data and your models become a powerful competitive moat. Vellum periodically runs model evaluation jobs in the background to see if we can find a different model that works even better for your use case. If one is identified, you can swap models under-the-hood – no code changes needed!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69757&key=user_uploads/1020427/72d1eb55-ddc8-4512-b674-1e409c4eb608)

P.S: If you’re curious, we recently published a blog where you can learn more about the benefits of fine-tuning and how to do it. Check it out [here](https://www.vellum.ai/blog/what-is-fine-tuning-and-when-to-use-it).

### **Trusted by companies on the bleeding edge of AI**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69757&key=user_uploads/1020427/f3a6ea0a-6b88-4b9c-81a6-8a4770e42e0f)


## **Our ask**

* Visit [our website](http://vellum.ai) to learn more, [request early access](https://www.vellum.ai/landing-pages/request-early-access) if any of these problems resonate with you!
* Spread the word! Share this post if you know of others looking to build applications using LLMs who would likely benefit from our platform
* If you’re thinking about using LLMs and would like to discuss your use-case with us, please reach out through our website!

launches.title: highlight.io - Open-source session replay & error monitoring
launches.tagline: highlight.io is the open source, fullstack monitoring platform. We help engineers reproduce hard-to-crack issues, and understand how their product is used.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68975&key=user_uploads/241768/1b79410b-8b41-4e1e-8869-c4ccfe7d2130)

## **TL;DR:**

[highlight.io](http://highlight.io) is an open-source **session replay and error monitoring** tool that helps teams reproduce hard-to-crack issues and understand product usage. We enable developers to understand WHY bugs are thrown on their web apps to eliminate the noisy alerts they get from more traditional monitoring tools.

[highlight.io](http://highlight.io) is already being used in production by **2k+ developers and 80+ companies**. Get started for free at [app.highlight.io](http://app.highlight.io) and give us a ⭐️ at [github.com/highlight/highlight](http://github.com/highlight/highlight).

### **The Problem**

How many times have you gotten an alert from Bugsnag or Sentry, and dismissed it because you weren’t sure about what caused it? And how many of you have an endless backlog of errors that your team _should_ triage, but haven’t gotten to yet?

We’ve found that when debugging an issue or customer request, **the toolset that you use is responsible for delivering one thing only: context**. And if there’s any gaps in this context, engineers are left in the dark.

To solve this, at our last companies, we found a lot of value in instrumenting a session replay-like tool, (similar to Logrocket or Fullstory), paired with an error monitoring tool (like Bugsnag). In fact, we’ve built these sorts of tools ourselves to hackily solve the problem. Enter [highlight.io](http://highlight.io).

### **The Solution: Session Replay 🤝 Error Monitoring**

With a simple `yarn/npm` import in your frontend and an optional import in your backend, [highlight.io](http://highlight.io) gives you session replay and error monitoring out of the box. This means that you can:

* Replay exactly what a user was seeing at the time of an issue/bug.
* Reproduce the browser dev-tools for every user session, including the network requests, errors, and more.
* Access all of the errors and exceptions (both frontend and backend) thrown in your app, paired with session replay.

Lastly, given the privacy-sensitive nature of the product, we have a very powerful privacy API that you can take a look at in our docs [here](https://www.highlight.io/docs/session-replay/privacy).

We’re just getting started! We have plans to go way deeper into your observability stack to give you ALL of the visibility you need; that means logs, traces and more! Join us on this journey:

launches.title: Lightski - Embed an AI data scientist in your app
launches.tagline: Embedded data analytics more powerful than Tableau and Looker by pairing AI with code execution
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Lightski helps you build an analytics experience for your users that answers any arbitrary question about their data. We provide embedded data analytics more powerful than Tableau and Looker by pairing AI with code execution, which eliminates hallucinations.

## Why?

Before YC, I was an engineering manager at Affinity CRM, where we spent six figures on an embedded analytics solution. Even then, our users were never happy; they either didn’t know how to navigate the complex UI or wanted even more advanced analytics. Most customers ended up exporting the data themselves and running their own analysis (not an ideal solution).

Recent AI advancements remove this trade-off, enabling a natural language interface and powerful code-based analysis. We started Lightski to quickly give your users the full power of a data scientist, without needing to know a line of code.

## User Experience

With Lightski, you’re able to embed an AI Data Scientist in your app, pre-loaded with your users’ data. Your users can then explore a dataset however they want; in response, we generate and execute code to perform analyses, such as:

* Create custom graphs, charts, and dashboards
* Perform arbitrary filters, group-bys, and aggregations
* Transform or clean data for a custom CSV export

Anything that a data scientist can accomplish in code can now be accomplished with Lightski. Best of all, your users won’t even know we’re powering the experience—you can quickly re-theme our UI with your design system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80683&key=user_uploads/68558/dea1307b-ab28-464c-acf0-f89373cf1dfe)

## Under the Hood

We rely heavily on state-of-the-art LLM models to guide the analysis, but there’s a lot of other capabilities built in-house that power the experience:

* Secure and isolated per-user code execution environments
* Native connectors for the most common databases
* Code-based ETL, for flexible data pre-processing and transformation
* Support for image generation and CSV export
* Embeddable streaming UI that supports custom theming

We’re building fast and will also soon launch:

* Interactive charts and even more customizable dashboards
* Direct API access to our safe code execution environments and ETL pre-processing features
* Guided assistants, for less technically-savvy users

and much more! Let us know if you’re interested in any of these and we’ll prioritize it for you.

## Get a Demo

The fastest way to get access to Lightski is by [signing up for our waitlist](https://forms.gle/Sj239WNvp5ZTLJGX6) or emailing [founders@lightski.com](mailto:founders@lightski.com)—we’ll help you format your data into a clean schema, and get Lightski embedded in your app within the day. Email us with any questions or feedback!

launches.title: Pierre - A new way to review code
launches.tagline: Pierre enables engineers, designers and business team members to discuss new features before they're merged.
launches.body:
Hi Everyone —

We are Ian and Jacob, and we are on a mission to modernize code reviews. Sign up for the alpha on [**HeyPierre.app**](http://heypierre.app/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69619&key=user_uploads/46928/b1f1d6e0-88b1-4a2e-b17c-0d5982d2543d)

Jacob (CEO) and Ian (CTO) met as early engineers at Twitter 14 years ago.

Jacob is the co-creator of Bootstrap (one of the largest and most popular open source communities on GitHub) and later went on to work as one of the first engineers at Medium. Ian was the first intern at Twitter, dropping out of college at 19 to TL the Twitter platform team.

Jacob and Ian co-founded a mobile app called Bumpers in 2016, which was eventually acquired by Coinbase. For the next 5 years, they led the Product Platform team at Coinbase and were the company-wide web and mobile DRIs.

### Github doesn’t solve today’s biggest engineering problems

In the decade+ since Github was built, tools that prioritize real time collaboration and discussion (Figma, Notion, and Linear) have exploded in popularity, but the circa-2006 code review experience hasn’t materially changed.

We’re building a new way to review code, and we’re starting with pull requests. As engineers with more than 15 years of experience, we’ve seen firsthand how cumbersome a pull request review is using Github — often, pull requests lack necessary context, take too long to approve, and cannot be viewed by non-engineers for feedback. Github’s comment features make it difficult to manage a conversation over time, and discussion is lost when engineers switch to Slack or Hangouts.

### Your code, conversations, and collaborators. Together.

Pierre enables engineers to shape the way that their code is reviewed. We’re starting with two of the biggest problems that engineers have:

1. How do you set better context?
2. How do you better manage discussions?

We’re taking features of the products you love most — the organized chats of iMessage, the real time collaboration of Figma, and the narrative structure of Notion — and we’re bringing it to code reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69619&key=user_uploads/46928/2f0b02fe-d44b-4605-a704-f66aa7736c4f)

Using Pierre, code review creators can:

* Set context next to the code
* Reorganize diffs intuitively
* Break up large pull requests into digestible bites

And code reviewers can:

* Be anyone — no more waiting for the bug bash to get design and product feedback
* Comment on anything — code, images or text
* Conduct real-time conversations right next to the code
* Get up-to-speed on changes more quickly

### Why we built Pierre

We’ve been intimately using GitHub since it’s inception (Ian’s user id is #91). There’s been a lot to love about GitHub over the years, but innovation on the core experience is lagging and other pieces of our toolchain are making us expect more. This is only exasperated by Ian living in NYC and Jacob in SF.

Engineers deserve a realtime, collaborative software platform optimized for productivity - instead of a slow, feed-based social network for coding.

### Try Pierre Out!

* Head to [**HeyPierre.app**](http://heypierre.app/) and sign up for our waitlist. We’re in closed alpha, but we can’t wait for you to try us out.
* We’re looking for a handful of fast growing teams (with \~25-50 engineers) to pilot us. If you know a team that could be a good fit, email [rachel@heypierre.app](mailto:rachel@heypierre.app). **Earn a $200 referral bonus for each paying team you bring in.**

launches.title: Metoro: Debug production systems faster with AI
launches.tagline: Metoro surfaces relevant metrics and logs, performs root cause analysis and suggests remediations
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Metoro is an AI agent which helps you debug production systems. Ask Metoro for help and it will surface relevant metrics and logs, perform root cause analysis and suggest remediations. It plugs into your existing observability stack (like DataDog, Grafana, Elastic, etc.) and debugs your system with you.

Hi everyone! We’re Chris and Tom, the team behind Metoro. We’re software engineers who have worked on complex distributed systems at Palantir and Jump Trading and are building the debugging tool we wish we had.

## The Problem: Debugging production systems is hard

Production systems are complex. It’s difficult to identify the metrics and logs that are relevant to the bug you’re hunting. This problem gets worse if you didn't write the code in the first place, or are unfamiliar with the system.

## The Solution: An interactive debugging agent that investigates with you

[Metoro](https://metoro.io/) acts like an experienced engineer. It understands your system and debugs your services one by one, updating its hypothesis as it discovers new information.

When it’s done, the investigation results are presented to you in an interactive dashboard for you to explore. This includes a root cause hypothesis, potential remediations and relevant logs and metrics for each service it looked at.

Metoro reads data from your existing observability stack. No application or infra changes needed.

### Ask: How you can help

* We're signing up teams from startups/scale-ups. If you'd like to try it or know people who would, please shoot us a mail at [founders@metoro.io](mailto:founders@metoro.io) or book a demo call <https://calendly.com/chris-battarbee/15-minute>

launches.title: Dioxus Labs - Web, Desktop, and Mobile apps with one codebase
launches.tagline: We make it easy for developers to build apps that run anywhere
launches.body:
**tldr**; [Dioxus Labs](https://dioxuslabs.com/) makes it easy for developers to write an app once and run it on nearly any platform. Our open-source Rust library has over 10,000 stars on GitHub and is used by Airbus, the European Space Agency, and Huawei.

—

Hi everyone, I’m Jonathan Kelley, the solo founder behind Dioxus Labs. A year ago, Dioxus was just a college side project. Now, it’s my full-time job, used by some of the world’s top companies. Before Dioxus, I worked at Cloudflare, interned at NASA, and researched plasma physics.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/df721fdb-e2c2-4cf3-b002-dc71be942743)

### **🥊 Building apps can be really hard**

---

Building apps can be challenging. App developers must navigate a complicated maze of tooling, libraries, and programming languages. Building an app that works on iOS, Android, Mac, Linux, and Windows is out of reach for many developers.

Small teams especially struggle with shipping cross-platform apps:

* Few developers know Mobile, Desktop, _and_ Web development
* There are hundreds of different tools to learn
* Current solutions are missing major features
* It’s really easy to build slow apps

None of the leading options like React Native, Flutter, Electron, or native make it easy for a small team to ship cross-platform apps quickly.

### **✨ How do we make it easy?**

With Dioxus, developers can write their app once and then ship it to users on the web, desktop, and mobile. Instead of learning dozens of different technologies like backend, frontend, and mobile, app developers only need to learn Dioxus to build and ship their app.

Developers build their apps in Rust with a React-like syntax and style their apps with HTML and CSS, making the onboarding from web development simple.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/b60dfc39-1d47-4028-99c5-86a906507f3a)

The project is entirely open source and written in Rust: developers’ most loved programming language.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/162ae1d4-16a7-47cc-89cd-b2166f43f415)

In the future, Dioxus Labs will provide a paid deployment platform that helps developers deploy and scale their Dioxus apps to their users.

### **🚀 Is it working?**

---

The past year has been great - the library has grown to almost 10k GitHub stars, 60k downloads, and companies like Huawei shipping production apps with Dioxus.

![star history](https://i.imgur.com/Idni1n9.png)

Airbus and the European Space Agency are building a [collision avoidance system](http://skytrace.space/):

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/e7130cf8-8e8a-400f-9c30-ffb7e84047d9)

[Satellite.im](http://satellite.im/) is building a [peer-to-peer Discord competitor](https://uplink.satellite.im/):

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/2d40c8b2-63e3-4f50-8da4-54589f4bd701)

A community member is building a [beautiful Mastadon client](https://terhech.de/ebou/):

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=73738&key=user_uploads/749074/74570fa3-f926-449d-865b-76eb6ebf46da)

### **🤝 How can you help?**

---

We’re hard at work building a deploy platform for Dioxus. In the meantime, we’d love your support:

* [Star us on GitHub](http://github.com/dioxusLabs/dioxus) [⭐](https://emojipedia.org/star/)
* Try out Dioxus for your next idea or internal tool
* Recommend a great Rust engineer who might be interested in working at Dioxus Labs

We’re around in our community [Discord](https://discord.gg/XgGxMSkvUM), but feel free to reach out directly if this is at all interesting to you.

launches.body:
# **Sweetspot AI Form Fill — Autonomous form completion for GovCon teams**

Leverage AI to finish RFIs, PPQs, security questionnaires, vendor packets, and teaming agreements, so your capture & proposal teams can focus on winning.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92424&key=user_uploads/1284150/387d941f-5586-48ac-93c4-72297f4ba53e)

### **TL;DR**

Sweetspot’s AI Form Fill is the first and only autonomous form-fill agent built for government contracting teams. Think of it as Cursor for forms: it finds every field (even unlabeled ones!) across _any_ document, then fills them with your validated company data and works with you to fill in the remaining gaps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92424&key=user_uploads/1284150/3bbc2cef-b307-4a0c-8e52-f871c64ace8a)

### **The Problem**

GovCon BD teams spend shocking amounts of time re-typing boilerplate data into forms that all look different but ask for the same information:

* 15-page RFIs that hide critical fields in footers
* PPQs and security questionnaires where one missed checkbox triggers re-work
* Vendor onboarding packets and teaming agreements that clog pipelines just when deadlines tighten

Manual entry steals hours from color reviews, strategy sessions, and pricing. Worse, each agency’s format changes just enough that no template sticks, and existing PDF tools don’t understand compliance nuance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92424&key=user_uploads/1284150/d0b6afd9-19d3-46cc-92b6-aac5b9cc04ed)

### **Our solution**

**Sweetspot Form Fill** replaces the copy-paste slog with an AI copilot purpose-built for the public sector:

1. **Autonomous field detection**\
   Our Form Fill agents scan the entire form, including headers, tables, annexes, and odd footnotes, to surface every required field, labeled or not.
2. **Live, accurate population**\
   We pull from your company data library and reflect all changes in realtime in the browser. No context switching or separate PDF tools needed.
3. **Ask-once memory**\
   If a field is unclear, Form Fill prompts you, stores the answer, and re-uses it automatically on future submissions. This means zero hallucinations and a full audit trail.
4. **Built-in signatures & edits**\
   Add e-signatures, tweak language, and manually add or adjust any field you need. One tab from first click to final PDF.
5. **Rapid-fire templates**\
   For truly repeatable workflows such as recurring state and local government bids, save a template and cut completion time to seconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92424&key=user_uploads/1284150/f84d23f3-5679-4ee6-9f78-72d8a78e06bf)

### **How It Works Under the Hood**

* **Semantic parsing engine** reads form structure, not just keywords, so Section M or SF33 blocks are never missed. It even works on poorly structured PDFs that don’t use annotations or native fields.
* **Domain-trained models** tuned on hundreds of thousands of GovCon documents ensure terminology accuracy (CAGE codes, NAICS, JCP, export controls, etc.).
* **DoD-Compliant architecture** means all of your data, answers, and content are stored securely.

### **Traction & Early Results**

* **12–18 hours saved per team per week** during beta across mid-market federal and SLED contractors.
* **3× faster package turnaround**, giving users extra days for color reviews, price sharpening, and all the other important tasks that go into winning their next contract.
* **Zero compliance rejections** to date; all of our users have been extremely happy with the results and have adopted Sweetspot Form Fill directly into their every day business processes.

Sweetspot already powers proposal teams at Oshkosh, Vannevar Labs, Strider, and other public-sector innovators.

# Background

Over the past few years, SaaS and financial services companies have been pushed by their customers to provide better business intelligence tooling. These systems are complex to design, hard to build, expensive to run, and challenging to scale. I've seen numerous examples of companies doing things like operating a database per customer or running 10+ hour-long pre-computation jobs just to deliver customer-facing data products.

However, during my time at Stripe, I saw a different model. I ran the engineering team that built [Data Pipeline](https://stripe.com/data-pipeline) and [Sigma](https://stripe.com/sigma), and due to Stripe's infrastructure, we were able to rapidly deliver new products that helped to retain some of Stripe’s largest customers.

DataShare is packaging up what I learned, and delivering that knowledge to the rest of the market.

# The Product

DataShare is a platform that combines a scalable, enterprise-grade data warehouse with a front-end framework for integrating business intelligence tools directly into your product.

Charts and dashboards can be built with a point-and-click UI and can be integrated with just two lines of code.

[Brian](https://www.linkedin.com/company/withdatashare/) - I spent the past 4 years at Stripe and the past year and a half as the eng manager for [Data Pipeline](https://stripe.com/data-pipeline) and [Sigma](https://stripe.com/sigma). Brian from DataShare

launches.title: Medley: Give Claude Code missions, not just tasks
launches.tagline: Medley is a free Claude Code plugin for work bigger than one session. Type /mission to turn an outcome into a live dependency graph, coordinate Claude Code and Codex workers, review the assembled result, and keep going.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Medley.

You type **_/mission_** and give it the outcome, the budget, and the constraints. Medley builds a live dependency graph, coordinates Claude Code and Codex workers, reviews what comes back, and keeps going when execution reveals more work. It's free and runs on the subscriptions and API access you already have.

<https://youtu.be/xe7bj3b5Aw0>

## **❌ The Problem**

Coding agents got good at bounded tasks. Once a job outgrows one session, you become the harness. You break the work into prompts, move context between agents, review outputs, and decide what happens next. There's no shared definition of done, so "finished" just means "looks finished."

## **🛠 Our Solution**

/mission takes on that orchestration. Three things sit between your outcome and the models:

* **A contract.** Before any work starts, Medley sets the objective, the acceptance criteria, the constraints and budget, and the conditions that should make it hold or stop. That's what "done" gets measured against later.
* **A live graph.** Medley doesn't write one giant plan upfront or spawn a swarm by default. It plans the next useful set of steps, runs them, reviews what came back, and updates what should happen next. Each node carries a brief, its dependencies, and a verification target. Sometimes one worker should carry a tightly coupled job end to end; when work is genuinely independent, Medley runs it in parallel. Work is routed across Claude Code and Codex workers - and with your own OpenRouter key, Codex workers can run models like Kimi and GLM.
* **An acceptance stage.** When a batch lands, a separate reviewer role inspects the outputs and changed files, runs the contract's verify commands, and decides whether the evidence satisfies the contract - not whether the work merely looks finished. If it doesn't, the mission replans.

You can watch and steer the mission in your browser. Anything that needs your judgment or approval - publishing, sending outbound, spending, contacting people - lands in the attention queue. Everything else keeps moving. 

## **📊 Why This Works**

The model is only the local capability. The harness decides where to apply it - the contract fixes the target, the graph splits the work, routing matches each task to a worker, and an independent acceptance stage runs the real verify commands and replans when the contract isn't met.

Before launch, we pressure-tested a benchmark-specialized version of the same architecture on four complete public benchmarks: 93.25% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 71.37 on HealthBench Professional, 93.24% on ViBench, and 60.98% on DrugDiscoveryBench. Those are the highest reported results on each, and they span coding, healthcare, and drug discovery.

No new foundation model. The gains came from how the work was decomposed, routed, carried across contexts, and reviewed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108332&key=user_uploads/1362282/3af52f57-057a-475d-8bc4-ec0b1531a504)

Full methodology and results are[ on our blog](https://www.medley.sh/blog/the-harness-is-the-capability-multiplier).

## **🙏 Our Ask**

**Try it.** Medley is free on Mac. Install it from Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Spine-AI/medley
/plugin install medley
/reload-plugins
```

Then run /mission.[ ](http://medley.sh/)[medley.sh](http://medley.sh)

**Tell us what you think.** We're shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email [support@getspine.ai](mailto:support@getspine.ai) with what you tried, where it worked, and where it broke - and where you'd want Medley to keep going versus stop and ask.

launches.title: Spine Swarm: Your AI Team for Everything Beyond Code
launches.tagline: Spine gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas to complete complex projects: research, analysis, financial models, prototypes, decks, and more.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Spine Swarm.

**TL;DR**

You describe a project. A team of AI agents spins up, works in parallel on a visual canvas, and delivers finished outputs: market reports, financial models, slide decks, interactive prototypes. Free to get started, no setup needed.

**Ask:** Sign up and try it at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai). We'd love to hear what you build — drop us a note at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai).

<https://youtu.be/vylx9rzC388>

## **❌ The Problem**

AI agents for coding have crossed a threshold. Tools like Cursor and Claude Code let engineers describe a project and come back to finished, working code. That experience doesn't exist yet for the rest of the work that drives a company forward.

As coding gets increasingly automated, the bottleneck is moving upstream: strategy documents, competitive analysis, financial modeling, sales collateral, market research, SEO audits, rapid prototyping. These are multi-hour, multi-step projects that require pulling information from many sources, structuring it, and producing polished output.

Today's AI tools treat this kind of work as a conversation. You get a chat thread, local file management, and one model doing everything sequentially. For simple tasks that works fine. But for complex projects, the single-chat paradigm breaks down. You end up managing the AI instead of letting it manage the work.

We've been building at this intersection for 3 years. Last year we launched Spine Canvas, a visual workspace for orchestrating AI models. Swarm is the next step: the canvas now has autonomous agents that can take on entire projects from start to finish.

## **🛠 Our Solution**

Spine Swarm gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas. You describe the project, and Spine spins up specialized agents in parallel, each handling a different part of the work. You can watch them execute in real time, inspect each artifact as it's created, and edit anything in place.

* **Multi-agent execution:** Spine orchestrates a team of agents across your project. For a competitive analysis, one agent researches market data, another structures the findings, another builds the slide deck. They work simultaneously, not sequentially, and can run autonomously for 80+ minutes on large projects.
* **Intelligent model selection:** We route between 300+ models, picking the best one for each step and ensembling multiple models to override any single model's biases. You don't configure any of this.
* **Visual canvas:** Every artifact your agents produce appears on a shared canvas where you can inspect, compare, edit, and branch. No chat windows, no file systems.

Everything Spine builds is downloadable and hosted at a shareable link. Just send your team the URL.

## **📊 Why This Works**

A common question we hear: "You're using the same models everyone else has access to. Why would the output be better?"

We recently scored **87.6% on Google DeepMind's DeepSearchQA**, a benchmark that measures how well AI answers complex research questions requiring multi-step reasoning across sources:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98705&key=user_uploads/1362282/fb8a5039-8780-455d-abc4-7f3da613aa7b)

Three things drive this:

* **Model routing and ensembling:** Spine selects the best model from 300+ options for each step and ensembles multiple models to override any single model's biases or blind spots.
* **Orchestration:** How you decompose a complex task, coordinate agents across steps, and manage handoffs between them matters as much as the models themselves.
* **Intelligent canvas:** Agents work on a shared canvas where they can read each other's outputs, build on previous steps, and assemble coherent deliverables. This also means every step is fully auditable, so you can trace how agents arrived at their conclusions and verify their reasoning.

Read more about our approach and the full benchmark results[ on our blog](https://blog.getspine.ai/spine-swarm-hits-1-on-gaia-level-3-and-google-deepmind-deepsearchqa/).

## **🚀 Tasks Worth Trying**

* "_Audit \[your website URL\] and produce a full SEO analysis, competitive landscape, and a prioritized growth roadmap with a slide deck._" You'll see agents browsing your site, researching competitors, and assembling deliverables simultaneously.
* "_I'm preparing to fundraise. Here are my company details: \[paste\]. Build me a pitch deck, competitive landscape with market sizing, a financial model, and personalized outreach emails for target investors._"
* "_Here's a product idea: \[describe it\]. Generate three different interactive prototypes and landing pages exploring different design directions, alongside a PRD and go-to-market strategy._"

## **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Try it:** Sign up at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai) and run one of the tasks above. It's free to get started, no credit card required.
* **Tell us what you build:** We're actively shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email us at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai) with what you tried and how it went.

**Share this post** if you know founders, operators, or team leads drowning in the strategic and analytical work that's piling up as code writes itself.

launches.title: Spine Canvas: Unlimited Visual Workspace for AI Thinking
launches.tagline: Think beyond chat. Collaborate visually across 300+ AI models with branching, parallel, and contextual workflows.
launches.body:
tl;dr: Chat is great for Q&A, but real work isn’t linear.

**Spine Canvas** is an unlimited, visual AI workspace that lets you orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription, think in blocks (Chat, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides), branch safely, run in parallel, and keep explicit context across everything.

Get started for free:[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)https://www.getspine.ai

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBq6dDQlO5w 

### **❌ The Problem**

Most AI tools force thinking into a chat thread. That breaks down for real work:

* **Superficial and linear:** useful for one-off answers, weak for exploration and synthesis
* **Context evaporates:** sources get buried; you can’t see what informed which step
* **No safe branching:** testing alternatives means losing your original path (or forking tabs)
* **No parallelism:** ideas wait in line; you can’t spin up multiple streams at once
* **Tool sprawl:** one app for research, another for writing, another for images — context gets lost between multiple AI subscriptions

If you’re doing market/competitive research, strategy, content systems, or product planning, you need an environment that reflects how thinking actually happens: exploratory, non-linear, and iterative.

---

### **💡 Our Solution: Canvas, Not Chat**

Spine Canvas is a visual workspace where your ideas are blocks connected by explicit context. You can see, direct, branch, and re-run your thinking — across hundreds of models — without losing your train of thought.

#### What you can do today:

**Orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription**

GPT‑5, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Flux, Nano Banana, and more — pick the right model per step and switch mid‑flow without losing context.

**Think in blocks, not threads**

Chat, Prompt, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides — each block has an explicit role and visual inputs/outputs, so chains stay modular and interpretable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/d6578fed-e2e5-4e9d-a749-a58b8ab47ccd)

**Organize and (explicitly) utilize all your content in a single workspace**

Paste or drop in PDFs, YouTube links, webpages, and even past LLM chats. Wire them into any block and control exactly what each step uses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/1e4420c0-d1a2-46fa-82db-cdf54eb15827)

**Branch safely and compare**

Explore alternatives without corrupting your original path. Keep versions side‑by‑side and merge insights when you’re ready.

**Run in parallel**

Take a list (competitors, themes, tasks) and spin out multiple research streams, drafts, or visuals at once.

**Re‑run and evolve**

Update one block and cascade improvements through an entire branch. Iteration becomes automatic and reproducible.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/47204045-5cb7-477e-afc9-55a447f0e165)

Our public roadmap:[ app.getspine.ai/roadmap](https://app.getspine.ai/roadmap)

### **💼 Real Canvases Teams Are Building**

* Market deep‑dives that flow into competitor profiles, battlecards, and executive memos — in minutes, not days
* Content engines that turn one source into outlines, drafts, and platform‑ready assets (with visuals)
* Founder/product strategy rooms mapping interviews (YouTube + PDFs) → insights → counterpoints → product bets → launch plans
* Creative labs exploring concepts, visual directions, and brand systems
* Learning hubs with curated sources, summaries, and living notes

Explore our gallery:[ https://app.getspine.ai/gallery](https://app.getspine.ai/gallery)

### **⚙️ Why This Matters**

* **Transparency:** See what each block knows — no black-box memory.
* **Control:** Direct sources by domain, date, or type; include your own docs and past chats.
* **Speed:** Complex, multi-step work finishes in minutes and stays repeatable.
* **Flexibility:** Model-agnostic orchestration keeps your workflow stable as models evolve.
* **Complete**: Do everything from research to generating presentation slides, images, copy drafts, all without switching tools.

Chat works for Q&A. **Canvas is for thinking.**

### **🤝 Ask**

* Try using a canvas for thinking instead of linear chat threads – build one real workflow (research → memo, content engine, or strategy room) and tell us what clicked.
* Share with teams who live in research, strategy, content, product or learnOps – we’re eager to add more templates based on your feedback.
* YC community: we’re always happy to chat about getting the best thinking out of your AI models — visually for individual workflows, and structurally through company-wide templates.

**Get started for free:**[ ](https://www.getspine.ai)[getspine.ai](http://getspine.ai)

**Join the community:**[ discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs](https://discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs)

The future of human–AI collaboration is visual, adaptive, and unlimited.

launches.title: Spine Research: Deep research done better
launches.tagline: Iterative deep research reports you can actually use.
launches.body:
**tl;dr** Spine Research searches through **_over 3x more sources 5x faster than ChatGPT Deep Research while keeping you in control_**. With a built-in full-text editor, you can iteratively guide the research, dive deeper into topics, and build and share reports that are actually useful.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cabKW-B9Ung

# ❌ **The Problem**

“Deep research” with AI often isn’t comprehensive, collaborative or controlled. If you’re relying on research for critical decisions, you’ve probably run up against the limitations of current tools:

* **Superficial Overviews:** Most AI tools deliver surface-level summaries. While a starting point, they rarely deliver the nuanced, comprehensive understanding needed for a true competitive edge or complex problem-solving.
* **Static Reports, Not Evolving Understanding:** Real insight comes from asking new questions based on what you're learning, and using that to inform where you need to go next. What if the initial research misses the mark, or you want to explore a specific avenue further? You're often stuck waiting 10-15+ minutes for a complete do-over, losing valuable context and any useful initial findings. Current UX isn't built for the way human understanding evolves – through continuous _refinement_ and building upon prior knowledge.
* **Lack of Meaningful Control:** Struggling to direct AI to your trusted websites, specific authors, or crucial internal documents? Or to exclude irrelevant noise? You end up sifting through low-quality information, wasting time and effort, because you can't effectively steer the research. It's hard to restrict research to just research papers, recent news or local government websites.

 For critical decision-making and professional analysis, today's AI "deep research" often feels frustratingly superficial, rigid, and disconnected from your own expertise.

# 💡 **Our Solution**

Spine AI rapidly generates comprehensive research reports by synthesizing insights from hundreds of websites, academic papers, news articles, and private documents—delivering deeper, more accurate understanding in a fraction of the time taken by ChatGPT's Deep Research. 

You're in full control to iteratively define the scope, depth, and breadth of analysis to perfectly suit your needs.

1. **Guide your process from the start:**\
   Start with your prompt and guide the research process immediately. Spine AI generates an initial outline you can quickly edit. Refine its scope, focus, or sources in minutes, ensuring precise alignment _before_ full report generation, so you don’t have to wait 15 minutes to realize you forgot to include a key detail about scope.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcL5A3u_PiTNIcT2zA_EuBzfnd1KkxzSX96-X_IXZip1X55JeOpSlewO6VSh2UnshndNmMQ0CIQLX2AJXZnl63DSKevcmLfEEZbmYFx4kNp4hSAMh6O8fSbOreW-syDJtskuGvYWg?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

2. **Control the process and build your understanding iteratively:**
   * **Breadth of sources:** When searching the open web, Spine AI accesses over 3x more sources than ChatGPT’s deep research, giving you a more comprehensive view with detailed citations out of the box. You can also exclude irrelevant domains, keeping unreliable sources out of your reports.
   * **Focused discovery:** Direct Spine AI to focus on particular types of sources (like news, financial reports, or research papers), specific websites, and set publication timeframes, to ensure the most relevant information.
   * **Leverage your own sources:** Upload and research your own private documents—proprietary reports, project files, spreadsheets, slide decks—integrating your internal knowledge with external discovery.
   * **Model Agnostic:** Maintain flexibility by choosing the LLM (including OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini models) that best suits your current needs or preferences. Your core research workflow remains stable, even as individual model capabilities evolve.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcT9SBLuKPWhEOCBukznBQTa76nsdbme7j2Tid7-TYTDxW-fxfMF37AHn7GwxQBR-b5E1rxcu9GWpjbdKWLgcoJV7q9SMyH0-ToypIKq63YfCWSBg1BTjXOle7IUb4h_GZ-DaGjJw?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

3. **Directly add your expertise:**\
   Spine AI isn't just about AI-generated content; it's a dynamic working document. You can type directly into your research, add your own notes, edit the generated text, and incorporate your unique context and analysis alongside the AI's findings. Close the gap between just another research doc to organize, and actually creating a usable report, or project doc.

# 🤝 **The Ask**

**Put us to the test.**

Need to build quick expertise on a new topic or simplify your research process?. Find out about how the [recent executive order on drug pricing could shift the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/62ab8a56-e0d5-4380-a991-18bf4fc2ffd0?utm_campaign=bookface), [what US-China trade negotiations could mean for startups and VC](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/0ee2928d-e0c9-4aea-b277-45f347d2b07d?utm_campaign=bookface), or [where Stripe is sitting in the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/105e8d40-36fc-4092-8555-853cf5865b40?utm_campaign=bookface). Also great for getting a handle on the latest research ([how much do we really know about ozempic?](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/ff4177f6-105f-4954-9fdd-a50261beae32?utm_campaign=bookface)), or whatever else you have questions about.

**Try us out for free!**

And with the YC promo code (YCLAUNCH), you can get $25 off our pro plans.

Know a founder, investor, analyst, or tech enthusiast who needs better research tools? Let them know about Spine AI. **Share with deep research power users**, and see if they don’t want to make the switch.

launches.title: Spine AI – The Multi-Modal AI Analyst Platform for Reliable Insights
launches.tagline: Simplifying data exploration at scale with AI analysts tailored to your business context
launches.body:
# Tl;dr

Accessing and synthesizing data is a challenge, with existing tools requiring too much effort and expertise.

**Enter Spine**: An AI-powered data platform built for decision-makers that handles your data in any format. Teach it your business context, to get reliable answers from databases, documents, and websearch. Gather your insights in customizable reports that automate multi-modal analysis and keep insights traceable.

To celebrate F24 Demo Day, **we’re offering free access** to a YC dataset in Spine, giving investors and observers a deep dive into batch F24’s companies, founders, and opportunities.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/425f4b5e-1eb5-48a6-bf02-25e69412564d)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/365e8fa7-e9c5-4489-adb3-281393120488)

# The problem

There is no shortage of data and information, or reasons to access it. Improving operations, identifying the most successful initiatives, or clarifying key drivers of revenue. But accessing and synthesizing this information from various sources can be an uphill battle.

Many tools available for working with data make it difficult to get to the right information without significant time and effort. Technical experts often have to unlock access for decision makers, and even then, critical details locked in documents, slide decks, or PDFs are hard to uncover and integrate effectively. 

While platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini offer “chat with your data” functionality—such as answering questions about uploaded spreadsheets or generating text-to-SQL queries—they don’t go far enough. None of these solutions offer an end to end solution that’s suitable for scalable use.

**You need to already have the right data, in a clean format, and not too much.** The big LLM providers can find some new information for you, but it can’t give you structured data at scale, and it’s not up to date.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/243f0c39-bd31-4246-9230-a330465ccdd1)

**It’s not enough to just do text to SQL.** It can speed up querying, but there’s a lot of business context that needs to be applied to make answers accurate and useful, and Custom GPTs don’t cut it. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/7f42be7d-d2d5-434c-8854-37792f39dc9d)

**There’s no good way to update information, add more data, or deal with multiple formats and sources at the same time.** People often don’t know the best place to find the information they are looking for, and most LLMs can’t help with that at scale.

**You can’t easily collect the insights you’ve generated from LLMs, share them, or re-trace your steps if there are questions about the source.** If you want to replicate a similar process for your analysis there’s no straightforward way, especially if it involves multi-modal data.

The major BI and analytics tools solve some of these problems, but they don’t really deliver on conversational functionality, and definitely don’t support multi-modality.

Which is why we’ve built a better way.

# The solution

Spine is a multi-modal AI analyst platform designed for decision-makers, delivering an end to end solution which includes:

**Explore and enrich data**

* Either start from scratch or add on to your existing data. Combine structured data, documents, and websearch for a unified view.
* Pull in data for competitive analysis, market research, benchmarking and more.

**Domain knowledge management customized for your use case, and ongoing evaluations for reliable updates**

* Our platform makes it possible to adjust, and test the integration of domain knowledge at scale, so you know updates work and are an improvement over what came before. 
* We generate 1000s of samples for each of our analysts, capturing issues so we can solve them, and know objectively that our changes improve performance.

**Integrations for your existing data sources**

* We work with data of all types, integrating with platforms like Google Drive, BigQuery and Snowflake, and industry specific tools like iLevel. Any tool that has an API can be set up.

**Transparent answers for users**

* Our AI analysts always show their work, so users can verify where answers are coming from and how they were created.
* If the analyst finds a question it’s not confident in answering, it notifies the user and gives them the option to submit to a human to verify its work.

**Customizable reporting and repeatable analysis**

* Full control and flexibility in reports and dashboards. Insights can be added directly from the chat, gathering information from structured datasets and documents.
* Create templates to automate multi-modal analysis, enabling you to apply the same framework seamlessly across multiple entities, such as different companies or similar data sets.

**In honour of Demo Day**, we’ve put together a [free preview of Spine](https://yc.getspine.ai/sign-up) with a dataset for batch F24’s companies and founders (plus as a bonus, data on all YC companies). 

If you’re an investor:

* Don’t miss out on discovering the best of the best. You can get a comprehensive overview of who’s in this batch, what they’re doing, and which companies are most similar, and figure out which are best suited for your investment thesis.
* Track the companies you’re interested in, and create a more focused view to compare them.
* Upload pitch decks and documents from founders to enrich the dataset we’ve given you, and pull key insights from them, such as traction, TAM estimates and GTM strategy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/517013a9-2a07-4c8b-abef-0ea809e7ad5c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/47430f02-c20c-42d8-9376-8591fc3d9058)

# The ask

**Try this free preview of Spine for YC F24 Demo Day!**

[Sign up](https://yc.getspine.ai/sign-up) and learn about the companies launching with this batch (or explore all companies in the YC directory!)

**Reach out if you’re interested in the full version of Spine**

We’ve worked with a number of investors in the VC space, but we’ve also created AI analysts for market research, sales data, and user facing experiences for B2B SaaS products.

If you think you could be doing more with your data, [reach out.](https://www.getspine.ai/talk-to-us)

**Spread the word**

If you like what you see, share it with someone you think would find it useful. \
Share this post, and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/95072305/admin/feed/posts/) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Spine_AI).

launches.title: Spine AI - Reliable AI data analysts that know your business
launches.tagline: Custom AI analysts, trained on your business context, so you can ask truly plain language data questions and make informed decisions frictionlessly
launches.body:
## tl;dr

Spine creates reliable AI analysts that make it easy to get the right data to drive decisions. We capture and embed your business context, to enable real plain language data questions. Instead of spending time struggling with inflexible dashboards, or translating questions to queries, just ask questions and get answers. Empower internal decision makers, or your customers, with interface options that integrate with existing workflows.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdtqKjuSuQpHE3TjAm_itXPgRLQtQgySxCTM0ReLQsAw3Gp_7wvbUIcGzUlUdy_WnNHsxizF0yn7oyA3Eb6ompQWp1RItXp80w1zaZWFZoAZgUQ4-Yk36b65S3_8LSTE5QTYAdgjqKrhkkzSBg6ZF45FUg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

# The problem

From having built over 200 copilots for companies and having processed more than 100k user queries here are some of our key learnings:

* Analytics and business intelligence are critical to running any organization. They allow leaders to understand what’s working, what’s not, and where they can find new opportunities.
* Most existing BI tools are inflexible and technical. To find answers to novel questions requires knowledge of the data model, or a BI specific query language.
* In practice, it's not always obvious what you'll need to know to respond to an evolving situation, or what new questions your data will raise. Static reports and dashboards create dead ends. You can get stuck waiting for someone from the data team to be available, or having to act on best guesses.
* And it's not just internal decision makers who face these challenges. Your customers can only interact with their application data through:
  * static dashboards that require engineering teams to build,
  * custom reports your support teams and analysts put together, and/or
  * data exports that require expertise to dissect
* While the extraction of information from unstructured sources has evolved, handling structured data remains a challenge:
  * Beyond accurately deciphering user intent, structured data often comes with messy table schemas and unwritten business context, for which there are no established methods of embedding in the models.
  * Simply having models generate complex SQL and/or code to process the data makes the execution less transparent, flexible and reliable.
  * Isolating data across multiple tenants and user access controls remains a barrier in making this a customer facing feature.

## The solution

We build custom AI analysts that allow any user to ask plain language questions about their data, and get reliable answers.

**Plain language questions and natural exploration**

With the chat interface, users can easily explore their data, asking questions in their own words, instead of "translating them" to a formal query. When the results raise new questions, just ask them. No searching for the right report, or getting stuck at a deadend in your dashboard.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXezHViIBc3TQimN4FoYsmGAuqFJ_lFgAQU8rTAGqPTGqoQmaN1l_FIxEwl8RvNWwRNJDQrVqL3w1ur0ziFjU069dzbYTwvorccXTDYPsPjD4CSqnRUMWnu4s89MT5Lgy-XfA3dqZJ5XunVddCXzeh97aw?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Revisit crucial insights**

Once you’ve found insights in your data, it’s easy to come back to. Get regular notifications for key questions, collect insights into shareable reports, or add them to flexible dashboards.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefxA1bWXpTkzW8hQBEekKMhZ4W3KPKIdetddq-1FWALX804CujEpigd2dQJjFVsEYVqE8MTsMRRzJ9mB6ahQkKQ7Rpxatwyp8AUgaVdLWKz0B8neUCiXXWM6uQbQWQXeFOwBBVHNETGCQGvQa5U1TJUrc?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Transparent and reliable answers**

Even on a single table dataset Spine’s AI analyst performs 15x better than GPT-4o out of the box.

Rather than leveraging models to generate complex SQL or code (or find answers from the data directly), our solution leverages a proprietary Data Processing Unit (DPU) that comprises a collection of refined modules.

The DPU enables us to:

* have individually tested and schema/domain fine-tuned modules that work at scale
* react to the data and modify the operations we take to get the answer
* explain the steps taken by the AI in a simple human readable manner

During the customer onboarding process, we capture and embed the business context and the schema understanding into the DPU modules. Additionally we build and maintain data and schema-specific semantic layers, across tables, which makes it possible for us to accurately interpret and handle natural language questions across multiple tables with over millions of rows each.

Finally, a combination of automated and human evaluations give us an objective way of measuring performance — both before and after we deploy the analyst.

**Diverse use cases**

We are able to support use cases across diverse industries and user bases by systematically gathering domain specific knowledge from our customers, and automatically inferring relevant data characteristics. Whether you’re in finance, retail, healthcare, telecoms, manufacturing, or any other industry, we can create an AI analyst for your business.

**_Sales analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdfoY8qAC_h6o37VqJhc9laUNLLsm2WoauY11Wzkq5Xn30kUo3sOqSGh5QQh8Z0In23MiAu5rTmss7DsZEFkpNUqwbVjH8-7lkmjcQTWE03g1U_Ce7bU_J5Tnaa34Om9RUW7onhyfiMfZBYYDhIg2bv82s?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Understand what outreach activities are getting attention, with who. Dig into team member performance, email deliverability and more, to better understand what’s effective and what’s not performing.

**_eCommerce platform analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdmVxwj3U-ohPX90hds_V_0qkRzBioVUgAOa7mZn0dJb3Bds-NSWsJAI2bfrQSnwVkAlwQ9n_KxmSXWXouOgqy4Tof9-GabGM6CC36-DMWTw53EJt8TuP5AYKCIJhxhWsXsU_aO9V0ZimmY5AW4FzW6Gg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Gain insights into which products are selling the most and why. Analyze customer behavior, optimize inventory management, and uncover trends in purchase patterns to maximize your sales potential.

**_ERP system analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_waVQSpbeRpOB3ZZjq_YGuu4scesyVCwj7txYLLoy6oyIzVUoSxEKyDuvkkjnXfG3JekB8U5Oq_I_wsbfAQSxLtdNw2QHrm6Yu9HQfmNQ5lMv7fLm1Sduavs0PyO3Fie2eqHih2I4amlPDb8exr_dy3I?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Keep projects on track by monitoring task progress, timelines, and budget adherence. Evaluate project performance, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.

**The power and flexibility of AI without needing a technical team**

You don’t need your own AI team. Have your custom analyst up and running in the next 30 days, and leave the upkeep to us. Monitor and tune the analyst’s behavior over time with our admin panel.

# About us

We are Akshay and Ashwin – the co-founders of Spine AI 👋. We've been friends for over a decade, with our shared journey beginning at the University of Waterloo. Our interest in machine learning took root in an unlikely place – a building called _Spine_ at the Nanyang Technological University in Singapore during an exchange term.

And in our first year we’ve grown! Across our team, we collectively collaborated with more than 45 enterprises, guiding them toward the next levels of AI maturity. We have more than 100+ citations in GenAI and patents in AI and data processing. Our team also has experience working at companies like Nvidia, Shopify, Instacart, Amazon, Epic Games as well as founding multiple YC companies.

## The ask

* If you need better access to insights within your organization, or want to empower your customers with their data, we'd love to [hear from you](https://www.getspine.ai/talk-to-us)!
* First 10 companies that contact us after launch get to trial a free, fully functioning AI analyst for your data! (Just let us know you heard about us from YC)
* Help us spread the word! Please share this post and join our journey by following us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/95072305/admin/feed/posts/) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Spine_AI).

launches.title: SID.ai – AI research lab for retrieval
launches.tagline: AI research lab for retrieval
launches.body:
**Intelligence needs Context**

AI is giving humanity a new computer: one that can learn, reason, and act. But intelligence and skills are inconsequential without context. _Context imposes the upper bound._ At SID, we're training models to provide this context. _To connect intelligence to the world._

**Context needs Retrieval**

To provide the right context, you need to find it first: Humanity has known how to do search on the internet for a while. But great search over everything else has been elusive so far. We think _we have an angle to solve it once and for all_. [SID-1](https://www.sid.ai/research/sid-1), our first agentic retrieval model, doubles embedding-only accuracy and outperforms frontier models on the most complex retrieval tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72952&key=user_uploads/1134710/cd8dc357-3db7-4db0-9476-265e176bb6bb)

**SID-1**

_SID-1 is our first model for agentic retrieval: 1.8x more likely to surface the right results than embedding-only search across general knowledge, finance, science, legal, and email. It is more accurate than agentic retrieval based on Gemini 3 Pro, Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-5.1 at its highest compute setting, while being 24x faster (144 vs 5.7 seconds)._

Traditional retrieval pipelines pre-program each step: query rewriting, searching, reranking. SID-1 retrieves like a human would: it searches, reads results, and refines its queries, taking as many steps as needed. We trained SID-1 on questions that take human researchers over an hour to solve.

SID-1 is drop-in compatible with existing retrieval systems. It is designed to work as a subagent with larger LLMs like GPT-5 or Sonnet. Teams running embedding-only retrieval or RAG can typically integrate it in an afternoon.

Step-change improvements in retrieval create new winners. Claude Code was better at finding the right file, unlocking larger code bases and driving massive adoption for Anthropic. Open Evidence made retrieving over medical research easier and took doctors by storm. Looking back further, relational was better than hierarchical for databases, creating Oracle. Better web search created Google. [_We're working closely with a small group of companies who want that edge now for their domains._](https://tally.so/r/gDDVMd)

Given we're compute-limited, we're rolling SID-1 out slowly. We're offering SID-1 through our API, AWS Bedrock, and as a self-hosted model. _If you're interested in SID-1, please sign up to our [waitlist](https://tally.so/r/gDDVMd), follow us on [X](https://x.com/SID_AI), or read the [technical report](https://www.sid.ai/research/sid-1-technical-report) for more details._
